data.one_liner: Run ML models on-device or in the cloud with hybrid routing and streaming inference.
data.what_it_does: The Xybrid Flutter SDK enables running LLMs, ASR (speech-to-text), and TTS (text-to-speech) natively in Flutter apps, either on-device or via cloud routing. It includes model loading, download progress tracking, structured output generation, tool calling, and OpenTelemetry observability.
use_when: You need local, offline AI inference (LLM, ASR, TTS) in your Flutter app.
You want to route between on-device models and cloud fallbacks dynamically.
You need structured outputs via GBNF grammars or built-in tool calling.
avoid_when: You only require standard cloud API integrations without local model dependencies.
You want a pure Dart solution without native plugin dependencies.
strengths: Supports completely offline and private native inference for LLMs, ASR, and TTS.
Provides download progress tracking and built-in caching for model registries.
Includes support for structured output via JSON schemas and tool calling.
weaknesses: Relies on native Rust bindings (flutter_rust_bridge) which add complexity to the build process.
Decision models and certain features have specific platform/device limitations.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing Xybrid in main() with WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized().

alternatives.name: tflite_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight TensorFlow Lite solution directly integrated into Flutter without the broader Xybrid cloud-hybrid routing framework.
